## 📝 Description


## 📂 Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 **Bug fix** (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ **New feature** (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 **Breaking change** (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] ♻️ **Refactoring** (code improvement with no logic changes)
- [ ] 🏗️ **Infrastructure/DevOps** (pipelines, Docker, etc.)


## 🧪 How Has This Been Tested?
- [ ] Unit Tests (Pass/Fail)
- [ ] Integration Tests (Pass/Fail)
- [ ] Manual testing in Dev/Stage environment


## 🛡️ Configuration Checks
- [ ] **Config Changes:** Does this require new App Settings or Connection Strings in the GitHub?
- [ ] **Database:** Does this PR include database migrations?
- [ ] **Security:** Have major dependencies been upgraded?


## ✅ Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the project style guidelines
- [ ] I have performed a self-review
- [ ] I have commented hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have updated the documentation (if applicable)
- [ ] My changes generate no new build warnings
